description: This file contains the definition of the 'Permission' class, which extends the base Controller class in the Opencart admin system. The class manages access permission checks for various routes within the admin interface, excluding certain specific pages.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: A controller class responsible for checking user permissions for accessing different routes in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the route specified in the request, ignoring certain predefined routes which do not require permission checks.
